summary.headline: H1 FY27 net profit fell to Rs 9.69 crore (17.87% margin) on total income of Rs 54.24 crore; H2 guided to Rs 58-60 crore revenue.
summary.overview: Capitalnumbers reported H1 FY27 consolidated total income of Rs 54.24 crore, EBITDA of Rs 13.54 crore and net profit of Rs 9.69 crore. Management attributed the weakness to slower replacement of churned revenue in its core business, a Middle East expansion that has under-delivered, a roughly 50% drop in other income, and higher group expenses. The company completed the acquisition of Epitome Cloud Inc (US Salesforce consultancy) on 25 August 2026 for about Rs 40 crore, and is pivoting business development toward the US and UK. Management guided H2 FY27 revenue of Rs 58-60 crore and PBT of Rs 17-18 crore, consolidated including Epitome.

financial_highlights.change: Management noted profit decline of about 34.5% vs prior period (analyst citation)
Drag of about 50% on margin decline

financial_highlights.metric: Epitome Cloud revenue (about 50 days post-acquisition to 30 Sep)

segments.name: Core digital engineering / existing business
segments.commentary: Replacement revenue for completed or reduced-spend projects was not won as fast as planned; client retention is about 90% (roughly 20 of 250 active clients lost, per management's figurative estimate). H2 core growth is expected to be weak, with H2 revenue guided at Rs 58-60 crore including Epitome.

segments.name: Epitome Cloud (US Salesforce consulting)
segments.commentary: Acquired for about Rs 40 crore cash (Rs 23.4 crore paid in August, balance later), with around USD 3.3 million acquisition-time revenue run-rate. Management expects 10-15% annual growth at similar margins; FY revenue around Rs 33 crore per analyst citation of prior-year figure, with H1 contribution about Rs 4.43 crore for roughly 50 days.

guidance_outlook: H2 FY27 consolidated revenue guided at Rs 58-60 crore and PBT of Rs 17-18 crore (said to include Epitome Cloud).
Epitome Cloud expected to grow at least 10-15% year-on-year at the same margin profile.
Management said it is not committing to any additional Middle East events beyond those already committed in the prior year.
Focus for the next six months is to plug the replacement-revenue gap in the core business and capture cross-sell opportunities.
Management expects margins to recover in the next two halves as the core business improves.
capex_capacity: Epitome Cloud acquisition completed on 25 August 2026 for about Rs 40 crore cash, subject to net working capital adjustments; 100% stake in Epitome Cloud Inc USA plus Indian subsidiary Epitome Cloud Private Limited.
Company is evaluating a Bay Area (Silicon Valley) office to build on-site presence in the US.
Cash balance of around Rs 150 crore; about Rs 41 crore of IPO proceeds remained unutilised, per management.
Company is continuing to screen M&A targets, with a stated aim of faster deployment of funds.
demand_pricing: Management said the US accounts for about 45% of operating revenue (analyst citation).
Middle East expansion additional revenue was below expectations and the decision cycle has been prolonged; the company is de-prioritising the region while honouring existing commitments.
Focus shifting to US and UK for new business, plus on-site deployment and Salesforce/sales consulting cross-sell.
New AI order of about Rs 2.4 crore from a UK entity for a healthcare AI project (time-and-material, six months), secured in June 2026.
An AI consulting workshop with a healthcare company in Africa has been completed, with a possible follow-on project not yet committed.
Epitome Cloud niche focus is CPQ, CLM and revenue cloud; management sees no near-term competitive pressure.

qa_highlights.question: Profit has declined about 34.5% against prior guidance of 15-20% organic growth; how can this be justified?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited slower replacement of completed or reduced-spend projects, under-delivery from Middle East investment, a Rs 3.2 crore (about 50%) drop in other income, Rs 1.68 crore lower operating revenue, and Rs 1.84 crore higher group expenses. Retention is about 90%.

qa_highlights.question: What is the H2 guidance and does it include Epitome Cloud?
qa_highlights.answer: H2 revenue of Rs 58-60 crore and PBT of Rs 17-18 crore, consolidated including Epitome Cloud.

qa_highlights.question: Why acquire a Salesforce firm for about Rs 40 crore and what are the expected revenue and profit milestones?
qa_highlights.answer: To build a Salesforce practice faster than organically and to gain a local US presence. Epitome had about USD 3.3 million (around Rs 30+ crore) revenue last year, and management expects 10-15% annual growth at the same margins.

qa_highlights.question: Why did other income fall about 50%?
qa_highlights.answer: Last year included gains from selling investments; this year none were sold. Investments are held at cost, so gains are not booked until sale. Other income mainly comprises fixed deposits and debt mutual funds.

qa_highlights.question: Is the Epitome business seasonal, and does it expect more than 5x H2 revenue growth from it?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said Epitome's H1 contribution covers only about 50 days post-acquisition, and the business has long-term contracts with regular billing and no seasonality.

qa_highlights.question: What is the outlook for the share price and M&A deployment given the unused IPO funds?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it is meeting M&A targets regularly and aims to deploy funds faster; about Rs 41 crore of IPO money remains unutilised and cash is about Rs 150 crore.

risks_watch: Core business replacement-revenue gap and churn of about 20 clients; whether H2 Rs 58-60 crore revenue guidance is met.
Middle East investment written down or idle; prolonged decision cycles.
Margin compression from lower other income and higher group expenses.
Integration of Epitome Cloud and whether its 10-15% growth at stable margins is delivered.
Pace of further M&A deployment against about Rs 41 crore of unused IPO proceeds.
Management's reliance on the Silicon Valley office and on-site model to lift US revenue.
summary.management_tone: Candid and somewhat defensive: management acknowledged the shortfall against plan and past guidance and attributed it specifically to core replacement revenue and the Middle East push. Tone was confident about the Epitome integration and US/UK pivot but gave few numbers on the core business beyond H2 guidance.
key_quotes: So that has led to a situation where that has led to the contribution to reduction in revenue.
We completed our first acquisition, which was I would call it early days, but it's having successful acquisition in terms of the kind of company where identified the evaluation at which we acquired.
So we expect them to grow by at least 10 to 15% on a year to year basis.

adds.what: Epitome Cloud Inc (US Salesforce consultancy) acquisition, completed 25 Aug 2026 for about Rs 40 crore cash; acquired rather than built, so counted as inorganic
Possible Bay Area (Silicon Valley) office for US on-site presence, under evaluation only

growth.why: Management guided H2 FY27 consolidated revenue of Rs 58-60 crore and PBT of Rs 17-18 crore including Epitome Cloud, and Epitome is expected to grow 10-15% a year, but core replacement revenue was not won as planned and the Middle East expansion under-delivered, so the guidance rests on the inorganic acquisition and a Rs 2.4 crore UK AI order rather than specific capacity.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: H1 FY27 net profit margin was 17.87% on Rs 54.24 crore income, with other income down about Rs 3.2 crore (about 50%) and group expenses up Rs 1.84 crore; management expects margins to recover over the next two halves as the core improves, but gave no numbers.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Epitome Cloud (acquired 25 Aug 2026 for about Rs 40 crore) is already commissioned as inorganic capacity, and a Bay Area office is only under evaluation; no organic capacity build is discussed.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: H2 revenue guided at Rs 58-60 crore including Epitome (about Rs 4.43 crore in roughly 50 days), but core replacement revenue was weak with about 20 of 250 clients lost and retention near 90%.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Rs 41 crore of IPO proceeds and about Rs 150 crore cash are unutilised, and management is screening M&A targets to deploy funds faster; utilisation is not disclosed, so no capex call on capacity.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Profit fell about 34.5% against prior 15-20% organic growth guidance, and H2 guidance of Rs 58-60 crore revenue and Rs 17-18 crore PBT rests on the acquisition and a Rs 2.4 crore UK AI order rather than core momentum.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Core replacement revenue has lagged plan, Middle East is being de-prioritised with prolonged decision cycles, and H2 core growth is expected to be weak, so the Rs 58-60 crore H2 revenue guide carries execution risk.

rows.label: US and UK pivot via Epitome Cloud and Bay Area office
rows.why: Management is shifting new business development to US and UK, US is about 45% of operating revenue, Epitome is expected to grow 10-15% a year, and a Rs 2.4 crore UK AI order was secured in June 2026.

rows.label: Epitome consolidation drives H2 revenue step-up
rows.why: Guided H2 revenue of Rs 58-60 crore includes Epitome, which contributed Rs 4.43 crore in about 50 days, implying a full-half contribution well above the H1 base.

rows.label: Middle East expansion de-prioritised
rows.why: Middle East added revenue was below expectations and management is not committing to further events beyond those already committed, so this region is unlikely to drive growth.

tone.note: Management was confident about the Epitome integration and the US/UK pivot but cautious on the core business, admitting the shortfall versus plan and past guidance from slower replacement revenue and the Middle East push; analysts pressed on the 34.5% profit decline, the Rs 40 crore acquisition rati

oneOffs.what: Year-ago quarter included gains from selling investments; other income down about Rs 3.2 crore (~50%) this year as no investments were sold
Epitome Cloud consolidated from 25 Aug 2026; about Rs 4.43 crore revenue in roughly 50 days to 30 Sep

quality.why: Core operating revenue fell (Rs 1.68 crore shortfall) and profit declined about 34.5%, while the headline is propped by a short Epitome contribution (Rs 4.43 crore) and the absence of prior-year investment-sale gains depresses other income by about Rs 3.2 crore, so the underlying recurring business is shrinking rather than growing.
